card.name: Inside rare proper names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a rare proper name split into several parts, such as a surname, eponymous disease or drug name. It fires after the first piece, e.g. Z|oll|inger, tort|oise, Pr|inz|metal.

modes.label: Eponymous disease names
modes.description: Middle of a person's name inside a syndrome or angina name.
modes.example: Pathological Hypersecretory Conditions including Z<<oll>>inger-Ellison Syndrome 60

modes.label: Surnames and place names
modes.description: Middle piece of an author, group or glacier name.

modes.label: Drug and odd terms
modes.description: Middle piece of a drug name or other rare word.

card.writes: It seems to help the model finish a rare name with its next piece, though the promoted tokens are mixed.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of an unusual name that has been split into pieces, such as Zollinger-Ellison.
